[[File:Tommy Santosuosso 2023 Beezer Bowl.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Tommy Santosuosso at the [[2023 Beezer Bowl]].<ref>[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1419629#p1419629 La Polka Live - How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love the Beezers], Players Committee forum (Pistone84, 21 January 2024). Preserved copy: [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t84078.html swccg.com snapshot]</ref>]]
'''Thomas Santosuosso''' (also listed as '''Thomas Santosuosso Jr''', '''Tommy Santosuosso''', '''Tommy Santosusso''' and '''Tommy S'''; forums handle '''LargePorg'''; GEMP handle '''LargePorg''',<ref name="org2026" /> '''tjs625''' in the 2022 [[Retro League]]<ref name="org2022" /><ref name="lp2022">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1367850#p1367850 Post by LargePorg], 8 February 2022, in [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=80048&start=20 2022 Retro GEMP League], forum.starwarsccg.org. Answering a sign-up ping to tjs62500, LargePorg says his sign-up was sent and attaches the file tjs625_SWCCG2022RetroSignup.png. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012222348/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t80048-start20.html Internet Archive].</ref>) is a Star Wars CCG player and Players Committee Social Media Team member.<ref name="pcchart">PC organization chart PDF (created 6 May 2024), [https://web.archive.org/web/20261010210152/https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf archived PDF]; [https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf live PDF]</ref> He played the [[2026 Boston Winter Classic]]<ref name="pc-rem">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-01-boston-winter-classic-boston-massachusetts-jan-10-to-11-2026/ 2026 Boston Winter Classic], starwarsccg.org</ref> and every season of the Retro League, and as LargePorg ran the GEMP sign-ups for the Retro event of the [[2023 Beezer Bowl]].<ref name="t83968">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=83968 Beezer Bowl: Gemp Parallel Event (RETRO) 29Dec23], Players Committee forum (LargePorg, 27 December 2023). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012151747/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t83968.html Internet Archive]</ref>
